ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels account for approximately 75% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels account for approximately 25%, concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white blobs are localized to the distal tips of both lobes. The left lobe tip shows complex mottling and dark vertical striations. The right lobe tip contains a solid white patch with internal dark veining. Small, isolated white circular spots are scattered across the central dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge. The left lobe displays higher amplitude, jagged peaks (approx. 20 pixels) compared to the more moderate serrations on the right lobe (approx. 10 pixels).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips along the trailing edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, heterogeneous textured clusters at the extreme distal tips indicative of barnacle colonization. Discrete circular white pixel clusters are visible in the central-left and central-right dark regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct diagonal high-intensity linear mark on the inner left lobe; a faint horizontal linear mark on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustation (barnacles) on both distal tips, characterized by multi-colored (brown/white/red) textured masses that alter the smooth edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark Y-shaped pigmentation pattern contained within the high-intensity white field of the right distal lobe tip.
